stablecoin.name: Stablecoins
stablecoin.description: Verified tokens intended to track a fiat currency. Membership describes the asset and does not certify its peg or safety. Yield-bearing receipts require separate review.

stock.name: Stocks
stock.description: Verified tokens representing individual company equity exposure, including individually verified wrappers. ETFs, bonds, commodities, and issuer governance tokens are excluded.

bluechip.name: Blue chips
bluechip.description: VFAT's curated list of established crypto assets with broad adoption, a sustained operating history, and deep liquidity. Initial underlying assets are BTC, ETH, and SOL; additions require an evidence-backed review rather than automatic market-cap selection. Direct wrapped or bridged representations are verified individually. Staking derivatives and yield-bearing receipts are excluded. Membership is not a safety rating.
